_about: Hasta Wellness, Aestheva's first venue. Venue facts from hastawellnessclinic.com; services, durations, prices and doctors from Dr Sooraj (October 2026). Confirmed by the owner: deposits are 20% of the price rounded to the nearest ₹100, minimum ₹300; tooth brightening takes 60 minutes; the clinic has one laser machine, shared by all laser services including laser tooth brightening; Dr Akshara offers dental services only.
name: Hasta Wellness
address: 1st floor, Anjali Arcade, near Nippon Toyota, Technopark Phase 3 Service Road, Kazhakkoottam, Thiruvananthapuram 695583
tagline: Dental, skin and hair care near Technopark Phase 3
about: A doctor-led clinic bringing dental, skin and hair care together near Technopark Phase 3, Kazhakkoottam. Your doctor checks that a treatment suits you before it starts, and explains the options, costs and aftercare. A venture of Haswel Care Private Limited, which also operates Aestheva.
amenities: Dental, skin and hair care under one roof
Fibe healthcare finance enquiries for eligible dental treatment

services.name: Scaling
services.desc: A professional clean that removes plaque and hardened tartar from above and just below the gumline, finished with a polish. A sensible place to start if it has been a while since your last visit.

services.name: Composite filling
services.desc: A tooth-coloured filling that repairs a cavity or small chip and is shaped to match the tooth. The dentist examines the tooth first and talks you through it if more work is needed.

services.name: Fluoride varnish
services.desc: A thin fluoride coating painted onto the teeth to help protect the enamel against decay. It takes a few minutes in the chair.

services.name: Tooth brightening (peroxide)
services.desc: In-clinic whitening with a professional peroxide gel, applied while your gums are protected. The dentist checks your teeth and gums first and tells you what shade change is realistic for you.

services.name: Tooth brightening (laser)
services.desc: In-clinic whitening where the gel is activated with a dental laser. The dentist checks your teeth and gums first and tells you what shade change is realistic for you.

services.name: Carbon laser peel (face)
services.desc: A fine layer of carbon is applied to the skin and then passed over with a laser. Often chosen for oily skin, open pores and dullness. Your doctor looks at your skin before starting.

services.name: Carbon laser peel (lips)
services.desc: The carbon laser peel adapted for the lips, often chosen for darkened lips. Your doctor looks at your skin before starting.

services.name: Carbon laser (dark circles)
services.desc: Carbon laser treatment for the delicate skin under the eyes, often chosen for darkness in that area. Your doctor looks at your skin before starting.

services.name: Carbon laser peel (underarm or elbow)
services.desc: Carbon laser peel for the underarms or elbows, often chosen for darker skin in these areas. Your doctor looks at your skin before starting.

services.name: Chemical peel (glow)
services.desc: A light peel solution applied to the face and removed after a set time, often chosen for dull or tired-looking skin. Your doctor picks the peel after looking at your skin.

services.name: Chemical peel (acne and scars)
services.desc: A peel often chosen for active acne and the marks it leaves. Your doctor picks the peel after looking at your skin, and may suggest a course.

services.name: Chemical peel (pigmentation)
services.desc: A peel often chosen for uneven skin tone and patches. Your doctor picks the peel after looking at your skin, and may suggest a course.

services.name: Laser hair reduction (upper lip and lower chin)
services.desc: One laser hair reduction session for the upper lip and chin. Hair reduction usually takes a course of sessions; your doctor suggests a plan after looking at your skin and hair.

services.name: Laser hair reduction (full face)
services.desc: One laser hair reduction session for the full face. Hair reduction usually takes a course of sessions; your doctor suggests a plan after looking at your skin and hair.

services.name: Laser hair reduction (upper arms)
services.desc: One laser hair reduction session for the upper arms. Hair reduction usually takes a course of sessions; your doctor suggests a plan after looking at your skin and hair.

services.name: Mesotherapy (face)
services.desc: Fine micro-injections of a treatment solution into the skin of the face, given by the doctor. Often chosen for dull or dehydrated skin.

services.name: GFC Exo mesotherapy (face)
services.desc: Mesotherapy for the face using GFC, a growth factor concentrate prepared from a small sample of your own blood, given by the doctor.

services.name: Mesotherapy (neck)
services.desc: Fine micro-injections of a treatment solution into the skin of the neck, given by the doctor.

services.name: GFC Exo mesotherapy (hair)
services.desc: GFC, a growth factor concentrate prepared from a small sample of your own blood, delivered into the scalp by the doctor. Often chosen for thinning hair and usually planned as a course.

services.name: GFC mesotherapy (hair)
services.desc: GFC mesotherapy for the scalp, using a growth factor concentrate prepared from a small sample of your own blood. Often chosen for thinning hair and usually planned as a course.

services.name: Anti-hair-loss mesotherapy (hair)
services.desc: Micro-injections of a treatment solution into the scalp, often chosen for hair fall. Your doctor looks for the cause of the hair fall first.
